Exercise 4. ⁧أولا⁩ · ⁧إذ⁩ · ⁧ثانيا⁩ · ⁧علاوة على ذلك⁩ · ⁧على سبيل المثال⁩ · ⁧لكن⁩ · ⁧لذلك⁩ · ⁧في الختام⁩ . Translation: I like to travel by train for three reasons. First, the train is comfortable: I can read or work during the journey. Second, it pollutes less than the plane and the car. Moreover, the stations are often located in the city centre, for example the Central Station of Milan. But the train isn't always cheap, so I book tickets weeks earlier. In conclusion, in my opinion the train is the best way to travel to Europe.
